scope: Derived process-median observations and statistical results. Original raw records, logs, environment and validation evidence remain in the referenced Actions artifact.

configuration.pairOrder: counterbalanced AB/BA; scenario order rotates by pair
configuration.cacheCondition: fresh processes; operating-system file cache and native-library extraction caches are not reset
configuration.withinProcessReduction: median of the declared inner timing repetitions

statistics.method: paired percentile bootstrap of the mean log candidate/baseline latency ratio
statistics.pointEstimate: geometric mean of paired per-process median ratios
statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni across every declared scenario/metric, including invalid metrics
statistics.qualification: Bootstrap confidence intervals are approximate; process independence and a stable host remain assumptions.
